# GalacticResource

> Domain research archive for the Milky Way. Literature reviews and primary-source analyses. Curated by Corgan Studio, Inc.

Research Archive: https://galacticresource.com/research/ (literature reviews by Corgan Studio, Inc., open to read).

## Research Archive

- [Exoplanet habitability and stellar neighborhood statistics](https://galacticresource.com/research/exoplanet-habitability-stats): Review of the exoplanet population statistics relevant to habitability - the eta-Earth occurrence rate from Kepler, the ongoing TESS and PLATO surveys, the M-dwarf habitable-zone-planet inventory, and the stellar-neighbourhood census within 10 parsecs.
- [Galactic chemical evolution from stellar spectra](https://galacticresource.com/research/galactic-chemical-evolution): Review of the Milky Way's chemical-abundance history as resolved by APOGEE, Gaia-ESO, and GALAH spectroscopic surveys, the radial and vertical chemical gradients, and the connection to the disc and halo formation history.
- [HII regions and star-forming complexes in the Milky Way](https://galacticresource.com/research/hii-star-forming-regions): Review of the Galactic HII region population, the WISE all-sky catalogue, the spiral-arm tracing methodology, and the relationship between HII region statistics and the Galactic star-formation rate.
- [Milky Way bar structure from Gaia Data Release 3](https://galacticresource.com/research/milky-way-bar-gaia-dr3): Review of the Gaia Data Release 3 stellar census and what the bar's confirmed half-length, pattern speed, and tilt mean for inner-Galaxy dynamics, dark-matter distribution, and pulsar timing.
- [The Milky Way rotation curve and dark-matter constraints](https://galacticresource.com/research/milky-way-rotation-curve-dark-matter): Review of the Milky Way rotation curve as resolved by Gaia astrometric data, the dark-matter halo profile required to explain the flat outer rotation, and the constraints on alternative-gravity hypotheses.
